title: Distillation Lineage and Homogeneity: Do Children of the Same Teacher Cluster?

original_idea.body: Distillation lineage and homogeneity: group models by lineage and test clustering recovers training lineage (arXiv:2510.22954).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: lineage as driver of correlated failure yields an actionable diversification rule.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Output-similarity clustering on open models; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (lineage-vs-homogeneity + dendrogram) with few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public models with documented lineage.
